name: Ethiopia
description: Ethiopia from Lucy and Aksum to Lalibela, the Solomonic emperors, Adwa, Haile Selassie, the Derg and today.

checkpoints.name: Cradle
checkpoints.note: Lucy walked here over three million years ago.

checkpoints.name: Aksum and Zagwe
checkpoints.note: Aksum traded across the Red Sea and became Christian. The Zagwe kings carved the churches of Lalibela.

checkpoints.name: The empire
checkpoints.note: The Solomonic emperors ruled the highlands. Menelik beat Italy at Adwa in 1896, and Haile Selassie led the country into the modern age.

checkpoints.name: Revolution and after
checkpoints.note: The Derg overthrew the emperor in 1974, and famine struck in the 1980s.
